findings.problem: For passing an exam, everyday German also very often uses schaffen (Hast du die Prüfung geschafft?), and the hint does not rule it out.
findings.fix: hint: an exam, a test; the exact word, not schaffen

back.target: to pass (an exam or test); also to exist, to insist (auf), to consist (aus)

note: The Spanish card pasar-pass means to go by or go through, not to pass an exam, so leaving sameAs null is right.
